semiconductor_relevance: High — BrushTek specializes in PVA brushes and sponges used for wafer cleaning in the semiconductor CMP process, making them a relevant supplier in the semiconductor manufacturing chain.
summary: BrushTek produces and supplies PVA brushes and sponges specifically designed for wafer cleaning in the semiconductor CMP process. They have successfully localized production that was previously reliant on imports and are now exporting their products to leading semiconductor manufacturers globally.
